native_result.query: Between which two races is the factor of BA degree completion -0.9568 when compared to the other?
native_result.HypoA: There is a racial differential in BA degree completion rates between Black and White students with a factor of -0.9568.
native_result.HypoB: The factor of BA degree completion is -0.9568 between Hispanic and White (and Black and White), where minority racial status compared to White respondents is associated with a negative factor of -0.9568 on completing a BA degree (BA DEGREE COMPLETED).
native_result.WorkflowB: Executed bivariate and multivariate logistic regression models and pairwise contingency table analyses on data/nls_ses_processed.csv across all racial groups (White, Black, Hispanic) to identify the comparative factor of BA degree completion.
